 Halloween with the Hogs 
 October 23, 2026 
 Tickets 
 Register: Trunk-or-Treat 
 Make your plans to spend Halloween with the Hogs at the biggest trick-or-treat location in the State of Arkansas at Razorback Stadium. For the first time since 2015, the Hogs will play in Fayetteville on Halloween to cap off the University of Arkansas’s 105th annual Homecoming Week. Fans of all ages can trick-or-treat from the tailgate lots to inside the stadium, the first 300 kids in costume get a free hot dog and drink and a Halloween laser show takes over halftime. Events begin on Wednesday night and continue through Saturday’s Battle Line Rivalry showdown between Arkansas and Missouri at 6:45 p.m. on SEC Network.
 Costumes Encouraged 
Fans are encouraged to show their Halloween spirit by dressing up for the game! Costumes are welcome as long as they are gameday appropriate and do not block the view of fans seated nearby; props are not permitted, and any face coverings must be removed at entry for security screening. A special student costume contest will include a cash prize.
 Gameday trick-or-treating 
Fans of all ages are invited to experience Halloween on The Hill with various locations for gameday trick-or-treating including the Official Hogoween Headquarters located at HogTown with a variety of different treat passout locations. Be a part of our Halloween Tailgate Contest where you can deck out your tailgate with your best Halloween spirit as we crown the Best Overall Halloween Tailgate! You can also register your tailgate to be included on our official Trunk-or-Treat map.
 Visit the HogTown Halloween Headquarters Booth, where all fans can pick up their gameday trick-or-treat bags and the first 300 kids in costume will receive a voucher for a free hot dog and drink, redeemable inside Razorback Stadium during the game, courtesy of Coca-Cola. Gameday trick-or-treat options include:
 ● HogWalk Pep Rally & Candy Toss (4:00 p.m.)
● Trunk-or-Treating in Tailgate Lots and Victory Village North and East (4:00 p.m.-Kickoff)
● Experience Fayetteville’s “Trick -or-Treat Trail”-gating (5:45 p.m.-6:05 p.m.)
● Gate 14 Plaza (4:30p.m. through 1st Quarter)
● South Endzone Food Court (5:15 p.m. through 1st Quarter)
 Stadium Laser Show Presented by Shelter Insurance 
Join us for special Halloween elements throughout the evening highlighted by our Halftime Halloween Laser Show presented by Shelter Insurance. Fans will also see pyrotechnic and lighting effects, a Halloween halftime show from the Razorback Marching Band and much more.
 Special Offers 
Celebrate our first Halloween on the Hill in more than a decade with a special family friendly, $31 loaded ticket courtesy of Coca-Cola. This special Hogoween ticket comes with a free hot dog, Coca-Cola product and surprise treat courtesy of Mondelez redeemable at Saturday’s game via this link . In addition to value concessions throughout the stadium, a special Halloween value location will be featured at the Gate 14 Plaza that will offer $4.99 12-ounce Busch while supplies last.
 FULL SCHEDULE OF ACTIVITIES 
 Wednesday, Oct. 28 
● 6:30 p.m. – Homecoming Pep Rally (Greek Theatre)
● 7:00 p.m. – Men’s Basketball vs Memphis (Bud Walton Arena)
 Thursday, Oct. 29 
● 6:30 p.m. – Women’s Basketball vs Cameron (Bud Walton Arena – Kids get in FREE with a Halloween Costume)
 Friday, Oct. 30 
● 6:00 p.m. – Volleyball vs Oklahoma (Barnhill Arena)
● 7:30 p.m. – Razorback Stadium Red Glow
 Saturday, Oct. 31 
● 10:45 a.m. – Tailgating Lots Open
● 2:45 p.m. – HogTown Begins
● 4:00 p.m. – HogTown Pep Rally
● 4:15 p.m. – Hog Walk (corner of Maple & Razorback + Lot 300)
● 5:15 p.m. – Stadium Gates Open + trick-or-treating opens at Gate 14 Plaza and South Food Court
● 5:45 p.m. – Experience Fayetteville Trick-or-Treat Trailgating Parade (from Upper Ramble to Maple Street)
● 6:45 p.m. – Kickoff vs Missouri
